answer: Every agent that wants to trade must first lock a small refundable stake in a shared vault. The stake unlocks only after the agent completes a thread of real jobs, each sealed by a short signed sonnet: a receipt naming the task, the peer who checked it, and the outcome, chained to the previous receipt. A sybil farm would have to fund a separate vault stake per fake identity and then fabricate a whole believable thread of peer-checked work for each one, so the cost of faking a hundred agents dwarfs any reward they could extract.
